```{r, include = FALSE}
#get sunset times for each city 
dfcity <- tibble(city = c("Austin", "Hartford", "New Orleans", "Seattle", "San Francisco"), 
                     lat = c(30.2676,  41.7637, 29.9511, 47.6062, 37.7749),
                     lon = c(-97.7439,-72.6851, -90.0715, -122.3321, -122.4194),
                     tz = c("America/Chicago", "America/New_York", "America/Chicago",     "America/Los_Angeles", "America/Los_Angeles"))
                     
dfdates <- expand.grid(year = 2012:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>%
  mutate(date = ymd(paste(year, month, day, sep = "-")))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
vcity <- unique(dfcity$city)
dfsun <- data.frame()

for(X in vcity){
  vlat <- dfcity %>% filter(city == X) %>% pull(lat)
  vlon <- dfcity %>% filter(city == X) %>% pull(lon)
  vtz <- dfcity %>% filter(city == X) %>% pull(tz)
  dftemp1 <- tz_offset(dfdates$date, tz = vtz) 
  dftemp2 <- dfdates %>%
    mutate(lat = vlat, 
           lon = vlon) %>%
    getSunlightTimes(data = ., tz = vtz, keep = c("dawn", "sunrise", "sunset", "dusk", "night")) %>%
    rename_all(tolower) %>%
    mutate(wday = lubridate::wday(ymd(date), label = TRUE), 
           date = as.character(date)) %>%
    left_join(dftemp1 %>% mutate(date_time = as.character(date_time)), by = c("date" = "date_time")) %>%
    mutate(city = X, 
           is_dst = ifelse(is_dst, 1, 0), 
           year = year(ymd(date)), 
           month = month(ymd(date)), 
           day = day(ymd(date))) %>%
    mutate(across(c(dawn:night), ~ str_extract(., "[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}"))) %>%
    select(date, year, month, day, wday, is_dst, utc_offset_h, city, dawn:night) 
  
  dfsun <- dfsun %>%
    bind_rows(dftemp2)
}
```

```{r, include=FALSE}

dfcrime_austin <- fread("Data/raw/Austin/Crime_Reports1.csv")
```


```{r, warning = FALSE}
dfcrime_austin <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(
   
    occurred_date = lubridate::mdy(`Occurred Date`),
    report_date   = lubridate::mdy(`Report Date`),
    

    occurred_time = sprintf("%04d", `Occurred Time`) %>% 
                    sub("^(\\d{2})(\\d{2})$", "\\1:\\2:00", .),
    
    datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(paste(occurred_date, occurred_time)),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    year = year(datetime),
    month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
    offense = `Highest Offense Code`,
   description = `Highest Offense Description`,
    crime_disorder = ifelse(description %in% c("FAMILY DISTURBANCE",
  "DISTURBANCE - OTHER","FAMILY DISTURBANCE/PARENTAL", "DATING DISTURBANCE", "VOCO - ALCOHOL  CONSUMPTION", "VOCO SOLICITATION PROHIBIT", "VIOL CITY ORDINANCE - CURFEW", "CAMPING IN PARK","DOC FIGHTING", "POSSESSION OF MARIJUANA","POSS CONTROLLED SUB/NARCOTIC", "POSS OF DRUG PARAPHERNALIA", "DEL CONTROLLED SUB/NARCOTIC", "CRIMINAL MISCHIEF","GRAFFITI", "DAMAGE CITY PROP"), 1, 0),
         crime_robbery = ifelse(offense %in% c(300,302,303,305), 1, 0),
         crime_aggravated_assault = ifelse(offense %in% c(402,403,405,406,410,411), 1, 0),
         crime_burglary = ifelse(offense %in% c(500,502,504), 1, 0),
         crime_theft = ifelse(offense %in% c(600:610,612:621), 1, 0),
         crime_mv_theft = ifelse(offense %in% c(700), 1, 0), 
         crime_gun = ifelse(offense %in% c(1500, 1503, 1504, 1509, 2408, 2409, 2410, 1502), 1, 0),
      
         crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
            crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
            crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property
  )
  
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#find sunset times
dfsun_austin <- dfsun %>% 
  filter(city == "Austin") %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  select(date, dawn, sunrise, sunset, dusk, night)

```

```{r, include = FALSE}
dfcrime_austin <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  left_join(dfsun_austin, by = "date") %>%
  mutate(
    call_time_str = substr(occurred_time, 1, 5),
     daytime    = as.integer(call_time_str >= sunrise & call_time_str < sunset),
    nighttime  = as.integer(call_time_str < dawn | call_time_str >= night),
    is_sunrise   = as.integer(call_time_str >= dawn & call_time_str < sunrise),
    is_sunset    = as.integer(call_time_str >= sunset  & call_time_str < night)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
    mutate(
      total_calls = n(),
      calls_sunrise = sum(is_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
      calls_sunset  = sum(is_sunset, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  head(dfcrime_austin)
  
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
dst_dates <- tibble(
  year = 2012:2024,
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2012-03-11", "2013-03-10", "2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2012-11-04", "2013-11-03", "2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)

dfcrime_austin <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  
  mutate(
    days_until_fall_dst   = as.numeric(date - dst_fall),
    days_until_spring_dst = as.numeric(date - dst_spring)
  ) %>%
  
  select(-c(dst_spring, dst_fall))


head(dfcrime_austin)
```


```{r, include=FALSE}
#keep prior variables
dfcrime_austin_daily <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(year  = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    day   = lubridate::day(date),
    total_calls, calls_sunrise, calls_sunset,
    days_until_fall_dst, days_until_spring_dst
  )


#Aggregate all incidents in the day
dfall <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum) 

#Aggregate incidents by time of the day
dfdaytime <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*daytime)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
   summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_day"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfnighttime <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*nighttime)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
   summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_night"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfsunrise <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*is_sunrise)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_is_sunrise"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfsunset <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*is_sunset)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_is_sunset"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()


#Merge all datasets (ignore warning as it is used to keep only real dates)
dfcrime_austin <- expand.grid(year = 2012:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>%
  left_join(dfall, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfdaytime, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfnighttime, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfsunrise, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfsunset, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfcrime_austin_daily, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  mutate(city = "Austin")

dfcrime_austin <- dfcrime_austin %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:last_col(), ~replace_na(., 0)))

rm(dfall, dfdaytime, dfnighttime, dfsunrise, dfsunset); gc()
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, include=FALSE}
crime <- crime %>%
  mutate(offense_desc = coalesce(UCR_1_Description, NibrsDesc))

dfcrime_hartford <- crime %>%
  mutate(
   date = lubridate::parse_date_time(
      stringr::str_extract(as.character(`Date`), "^[0-9]{1,4}[/-][0-9]{1,2}[/-][0-9]{1,4}"),
      orders = c("mdy", "ymd")
    ),

time = coalesce(
  as.character(Time_24HR),
  as.character(Time)
) %>%
  str_pad(width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0") %>%
  sub("^(\\d{2})(\\d{2})$", "\\1:\\2:00", .),

datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(paste(as.Date(date), time)),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    year = year(datetime),
    month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
crime_disorder = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "DISTURBANCE - OTHER","FAMILY DISTURBANCE/PARENTAL", "DATING DISTURBANCE",
  "VOCO - ALCOHOL  CONSUMPTION", "VOCO SOLICITATION PROHIBIT",
  "VIOL CITY ORDINANCE - CURFEW", "CAMPING IN PARK","DOC FIGHTING",
  "POSSESSION OF MARIJUANA","POSS CONTROLLED SUB/NARCOTIC",
  "POSS OF DRUG PARAPHERNALIA", "DEL CONTROLLED SUB/NARCOTIC",
  "CRIMINAL MISCHIEF","GRAFFITI", "DAMAGE CITY PROP",
  
  "DISORDERLY CONDUCT", "DESTRUCTIVE/DAMAGE/VANDALISM OF PROPERTY",
  "LIQUOR LAW VIOLATIONS", "CURFEW/LOITERING/VAGRANCY VIOLATIONS",
  "DRUG EQUIPMENT VIOLATIONS", "DRUG/NARCOTIC VIOLATIONS", "FAMILY OFFENSES , NONVIOLENT"
)),

crime_robbery = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "ROBBERY-HANDS *STREET*", "ROBBERY-GUN *STREET*",  # UCR 
  "ROBBERY"                                            # NIBRS 
)),
crime_aggravated_assault = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "ASSLT-2-WEAPON", "ASSLT-2-KNIFE", "ASSLT-1-GUN", "ASSLT-2-GUN", "ASSLT-1-KNIFE",
  "AGGRAVATED ASSAULT"
)),
crime_burglary = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "BURG3-RES-DAY", "BURG2-RES-NITE", "BURG3-COM-NITE",
  "BURGLARY/BREAKING AND ENTERING"
)),
crime_mv_theft = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "M/V-THEFT AUTO", "USE MV WO PERM",
  "MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT"
)),
crime_theft = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "LARC4-M/V PART-STO-PLATE", "LARC3-FROM M/V", "LARC4 SHOPLIFT",
  "LARC4-FROM M/V", "LARC3-BUILDING", "LARC4-BUILDING", "LARC3 SHOPLIFT",
  "LARC3M/V PART", "LARC2-FROM M/V", "LARC4-REC-POSS-STO-PL/ARR",
  "LARC3-MISCELL", "LARC3-M/V PART", "LARC4-MISCELL", "LARC2-BUILDING",
  "ALL OTHER LARCENY", "SHOPLIFTING", "THEFT FROM BUILDINGS",
  "THEFT FROM COIN-OPERATED MACHINE OR DEVICE", "THEFT FROM MOTOR VEHICLE",
  "THEFT OF MOTOR VEHICLE PARTS OR ACCESSORIES", "POCKET PICKING",
  "PURSE SNATCHING", "STOLEN PROPERTY OFFENSES (RECEIVING, ETC.)"
)),
crime_gun = as.integer(offense_desc %in% c(
  "SHOTS FIRED - UNCONFIRMED", "SHOTS FIRED - CONFIRMED",
  "WEAPON LAW VIOLATIONS" #NIBRS (more vauge, no alternatives)
)),
    
 crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
    crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
    crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property

  )
```

```{r, warning = FALSE}
    year = year(datetime),
    month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
crime_disorder = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
  "DISTURBANCE (DOMESTIC)", "DISTURBANCE", "DISTURBANCE (FIGHT)", "DISTURBANCE (MENTAL)",
  "SIMPLE CRIMINAL DAMAGE", "SIMPLE CRIMINAL DAMAGE (DOMESTIC)", "AGGRAVATED CRIMINAL DAMAGE",
  "CRIMINAL MISCHIEF", "THREATS", "THREATS (DOMESTIC)", "UNDERAGE DRINKING",
  "PROSTITUTION", "OBSCENITY")),
crime_gun = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
  "ILLEGAL CARRYING OF A GUN", "ILLEGAL USE OF WEAPONS", "ILLEGAL CARRYING OF A WEAPON")),
crime_robbery = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
  "ARMED ROBBERY (GUN)", "SIMPLE ROBBERY", "ARMED ROBBERY", "ATTEMPTED ARMED ROBBERY (GUN)",
  "ARMED CARJACKING", "PROPERTY SNATCHING")),
crime_aggravated_assault = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
  "AGGRAVATED ASSAULT", "AGGRAVATED ASSAULT (DOMESTIC)", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY (SHOOTING)",
  "AGGRAVATED BATTERY (CUTTING)", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY", "AGGRAVATED BATTERY (DOMESTIC)")),
crime_burglary = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
  "SIMPLE BURGLARY (RESIDENCE)", "SIMPLE BURGLARY",
  "SIMPLE BURGLARY (BUSINESS)", "AGGRAVATED BURGLARY", "AGGRAVATED BURGLARY (DOMESTIC)",
  "ATTEMPTED SIMPLE BURGLARY (RESIDENCE)",
  "ATTEMPTED SIMPLE BURGLARY (BUSINESS)")),
crime_theft = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
 "THEFT", "SHOPLIFTING", "THEFT BY FRAUD", "LOST PROPERTY", "LOST OR STOLEN",
  "THEFT FROM EXTERIOR OF VEHICLE", "PICKPOCKET", "BICYCLE THEFT",
"ATTEMPTED THEFT", "ATTEMPTED SHOPLIFITING",
  "POSSESSION OF STOLEN PROPERTY", "EMBEZZLEMENT")),
crime_mv_theft = as.integer(`Signal_Description` %in% c(
   "SIMPLE BURGLARY (VEHICLE)", "ATTEMPTED SIMPLE BURGLARY (VEHICLE)", "AUTO THEFT", "ATTEMPTED AUTO THEFT", "AUTO THEFT & RECOVERY")),
    
 crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
    crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
    crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property

  )
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2012-03-11", "2013-03-10", "2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2012-11-04", "2013-11-03", "2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)

dfcrime_new_orleans <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  
  mutate(
    days_until_fall_dst   = as.numeric(date - dst_fall),
    days_until_spring_dst = as.numeric(date - dst_spring)
  ) %>%
  
  select(-c(dst_spring, dst_fall))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
#keep prior variables
dfcrime_new_orleans_daily <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  distinct(date, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(year  = lubridate::year(date),
    month = lubridate::month(date),
    day   = lubridate::day(date),
    total_calls, calls_sunrise, calls_sunset,
    days_until_fall_dst, days_until_spring_dst
  )


#Aggregate all incidents in the day
dfall <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum) 

#Aggregate incidents by time of the day
dfdaytime <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*daytime)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
   summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_day"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfnighttime <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*nighttime)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
   summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_night"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfsunrise <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*is_sunrise)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_is_sunrise"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()

dfsunset <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:crime_index, ~.*is_sunset)) %>%
  group_by(year, month, day) %>%
  summarise_at(vars(crime_disorder:crime_index), sum)  %>%
  rename_with(function(x) str_replace(x, "$", "_is_sunset"), starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  as.data.frame()


#Merge all datasets (ignore warning as it is used to keep only real dates)
dfcrime_new_orleans <- expand.grid(year = 2012:2024, month = 1:12, day = 1:31) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(ymd(paste(year, month, day)))) %>%
  left_join(dfall, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfdaytime, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfnighttime, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfsunrise, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfsunset, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  left_join(dfcrime_new_orleans_daily, by = c("year", "month", "day")) %>%
  mutate(city = "New Orleans")

dfcrime_new_orleans <- dfcrime_new_orleans %>%
  mutate(across(crime_disorder:last_col(), ~replace_na(., 0)))

rm(dfall, dfdaytime, dfnighttime, dfsunrise, dfsunset); gc()
```

```{r, warning = FALSE, include=FALSE}

dfcrime_seattle <- crime %>%
rename_all(~ str_replace_all(tolower(.), "[ _]", ".")) %>%
  distinct(report.number, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = mdy_hms(offense.end.datetime), 
   date = as.Date(datetime),
    time = format(datetime, "%H:%M:%S"),
    
    year = year(datetime),
    month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
crime_disorder = as.integer(offense %in% c(
"Intimidation", "Family Offenses, Nonviolent")),
crime_gun = as.integer(offense == "Weapon Law Violations"),
crime_robbery = as.integer(offense== "Robbery"),
crime_aggravated_assault = as.integer(offense == "Aggravated Assault"),
crime_burglary = as.integer(offense == "Burglary/Breaking & Entering"),
crime_theft = as.integer(offense %in% c(
 "All Other Larceny", "Shoplifting", "Theft From Building", "Pocket-picking")),
crime_mv_theft = as.integer(offense  %in% c(
   "Motor Vehicle Theft", "Theft From Motor Vehicle", "Theft of Motor Vehicle Parts or Accessories")),
    
 crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
    crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
    crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property

  )
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
  mutate(
    call_time_str = substr(time, 1, 5),
     daytime    = as.integer(call_time_str >= sunrise & call_time_str < sunset),
    nighttime  = as.integer(call_time_str < dawn | call_time_str >= night),
    is_sunrise   = as.integer(call_time_str >= dawn & call_time_str < sunrise),
    is_sunset    = as.integer(call_time_str >= sunset  & call_time_str < night)
  ) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
    mutate(
      total_calls = n(),
      calls_sunrise = sum(is_sunrise, na.rm = TRUE),
      calls_sunset  = sum(is_sunset, na.rm = TRUE),
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}

crime_1 <- fread("Data/raw/San_Francisco/Crimes/Police_Department_Incident_Reports__Historical_2003_to_May_2018.csv",
                 select = c("IncidntNum", "Date", "Time", "Category", "Descript", "Incident Code"), check.names = TRUE) %>%
  rename_all(tolower) %>% 
  distinct(incidntnum, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
   date = lubridate::mdy(date),
      time = ifelse(nchar(time) == 5, paste0(time, ":00"), time),
                         
    datetime = lubridate::ymd_hms(paste(date, time)),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    year = year(datetime),
        month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
         crime_disorder = ifelse(category %in% c("LIQUOR LAWS", "DISORDERLY CONDUCT", "VANDALISM", "DRUG/NARCOTIC"), 1, 0),
         crime_robbery = ifelse(category %in% "ROBBERY", 1, 0),
         crime_aggravated_assault = ifelse(category %in% "ASSAULT" & grepl("AGGRAVATED", descript), 1, 0),
         crime_burglary = ifelse(category %in% "BURGLARY", 1, 0),
         crime_theft = ifelse(category %in% "LARCENY/THEFT", 1, 0),
         crime_mv_theft = ifelse(category %in% "VEHICLE THEFT", 1, 0), 
         crime_gun = ifelse(category %in% "WEAPON LAWS", 1, 0),
   
    crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
    crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
    crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property
   
         ) %>%
  as.data.frame()


crime_2 <- fread("Data/raw/San_Francisco/Crimes/Police_Department_Incident_Reports__2018_to_Present.csv", check.names = TRUE) %>%
  rename_all(tolower) %>% 
   distinct(incident.number, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = lubridate::parse_date_time(incident.datetime, orders = "ymd IMS p"),
    date = as.Date(datetime),
    time = format(datetime, "%H:%M:%S"),
    
    
    year = year(datetime),
    month    = lubridate::month(datetime),  
    day  = lubridate::day(datetime),
    day_of_week = lubridate::wday(datetime, week_start = 1),
    hour = hour(datetime), 
    minute = minute(datetime),
    
crime_disorder = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Vandalism", "Disorderly Conduct", "Drunkenness", "Liquor Law Violation",
  "Prostitution")),
crime_gun = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Weapons Offense")),
crime_robbery = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Robbery - Other", "Robbery - Commercial", "Robbery - Street")),
crime_aggravated_assault = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Aggravated Assault")),
crime_burglary = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Burglary - Other", "Burglary - Residential", "Burglary - Commercial", "Burglary - Hot Prowl")),
crime_theft = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
"Larceny Theft - Other", "Larceny Theft - Shoplifting",
  "Larceny Theft - From Building", "Larceny Theft - Bicycle",
  "Larceny - Auto Parts", "Larceny Theft - Pickpocket", "Stolen Property", "Embezzlement")),
crime_mv_theft = as.integer(incident.subcategory %in% c(
  "Robbery - Carjacking", "Larceny - From Vehicle",  "Theft From Vehicle", "Motor Vehicle Theft", "Motor Vehicle Theft (Attempted)")),
    
 crime_violent = crime_robbery + crime_aggravated_assault,
    crime_property = crime_burglary + crime_theft + crime_mv_theft,
    crime_index = crime_violent + crime_property

  ) %>% filter(date >= ymd("2018-05-16"))

dfcrime_san_francisco <- crime_1 %>%
  bind_rows(crime_2)
```

```{r, include = FALSE}
#combine files

city_files <- c(
  "Austin"        = "Data/processed/dfcrime_austin_intermediate.csv",
  "Hartford"      = "Data/processed/dfcrime_hartford_intermediate.csv",
  "New Orleans"   = "Data/processed/dfcrime_new_orleans_intermediate.csv",
  "Seattle"       = "Data/processed/dfcrime_seattle_intermediate.csv",
  "San Francisco" = "Data/processed/dfcrime_san_francisco_intermediate.csv"
)


dflist_all <- vector("list", length(city_files))

for (i in seq_along(city_files)) {
  dftemp <- fread(city_files[i])
  dftemp[, city := names(city_files)[i]]
  dflist_all[[i]] <- dftemp
  rm(dftemp); gc()
}


dfcrime_all <- rbindlist(dflist_all, fill = TRUE)


table(dfcrime_all$city)
dim(dfcrime_all)

rm(dflist_all); gc()
```

```{r, fig.width = 10}
#RD 

dst_dates <- tibble(
  year = 2012:2024,
  dst_spring = as.Date(c("2012-03-11", "2013-03-10", "2014-03-09", "2015-03-08", "2016-03-13", "2017-03-12", "2018-03-11", "2019-03-10", "2020-03-08", "2021-03-14", "2022-03-13", "2023-03-12", "2024-03-10")),
  dst_fall = as.Date(c("2012-11-04", "2013-11-03", "2014-11-02", "2015-11-01", "2016-11-06", "2017-11-05", "2018-11-04", "2019-11-03", "2020-11-01", "2021-11-07", "2022-11-06", "2023-11-05", "2024-11-03"))
)


plottheme <- theme( 
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15), 
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20), 
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
  strip.text.x = element_text(size = 12), 
  strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey85", color = "black"), 
  panel.background = element_blank(),  
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
  legend.key = element_rect(colour = "transparent", fill = "transparent"), 
  legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"), 
  legend.text = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.title = element_text(size = 20), 
  legend.position = "none", 
  rect = element_rect(fill = "transparent")
  )

dfcrime_all <- dfcrime_all %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, month, day)))

crime_sunset <- dfcrime_all %>%
  select(
    city,
    date,
    starts_with("crime_") & ends_with("_is_sunset")
  )

crime_sorted_night <- crime_sunset %>%
  select(city, date, starts_with("crime_")) %>%
  group_by(city, date) %>%
  summarise(
    across(starts_with("crime_"), \(x) sum(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

dst_rd_spring <- crime_sorted_night %>%
  mutate( 
    date = as.Date(date),
    year = year(date)
    ) %>%
  left_join(dst_dates, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(days_until_spring = as.integer(date - dst_spring)) %>%
  filter(days_until_spring %in% -21:21) %>%
  mutate(
    dst_on = if_else(days_until_spring >= 0, "yes", "no")
  ) %>%
  group_by(days_until_spring, dst_on) %>%
   summarise(
    across(
      starts_with("crime_"),
      ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

vnames <- dst_rd_spring %>% select(starts_with("crime_")) %>% names()


for(X in vnames){ 

  f1 <- as.formula(paste0(X, "~ poly(days_until_spring, 2)")) 
  sub_no  <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "no")
  sub_yes <- dst_rd_spring %>% filter(dst_on == "yes")
  
  if(length(unique(sub_no$days_until_spring)) < 3 | length(unique(sub_yes$days_until_spring)) < 3) next

  lm1 <- lm(f1, data = sub_no)
  lm2 <- lm(f1, data = sub_yes)
  pred1 <- predict(lm1, newdata = sub_no, se = TRUE)
  pred2 <- predict(lm2, newdata = sub_yes, se = TRUE)

  dst_rd_spring_plot <- bind_rows(sub_no, sub_yes) %>%
    mutate(pred = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit), 
           upper = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) - qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit), 
           lower = c(pred1$fit, pred2$fit) + qnorm(0.975)*c(pred1$se.fit, pred2$se.fit)) 

  clean_title <- X %>% 
    str_replace("crime_", "") %>% 
    str_replace("_", " ") %>% 
    str_to_title()
  
  ylabel <- ifelse(str_detect(X, "clearedrate"), "Clearance rate", "Crimes") 
  
p <- ggplot(dst_rd_spring_plot, aes(x = days_until_spring, y = .data[[X]])) + 
    geom_point(aes(group = dst_on), size = 3, color = "royalblue", shape = 1) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = pred, group = dst_on)) + 
    geom_line(aes(y = upper, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_line(aes(y = lower, group = dst_on), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7, color = "grey80") + 
    geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +  
    labs(title = paste("All 911 RD:", clean_title), 
         x = "Days until Spring DST starts", 
         y = ylabel)
print(p)
}
```
